finalText:
I wrote the 4.2.0 section into `CHANGELOG.md`. Out of 380 commits, only one feature and about a dozen fixes actually touch what users see. Everything else was dependency bumps, refactors, and test churn.

The real changes: webhook deliveries now retry with backoff, paginators stop crashing on a null cursor, expired tokens return 401 instead of 403, request bodies stopped getting logged in full, and trace IDs now survive retries. A few smaller ones too — duplicate headers, histogram units, trailing slashes, empty allowlists, a timer leak, clearer parser errors.

No breaking changes this cycle, so I left that heading out, same as 4.0.3 did.
